summary: Re-tested the iteration_4 CRITICAL bug fix. Anonymous /feed now renders the 6-item FALLBACK_FEED with counter '1 of 6' (spinner disappears in <2s despite Firestore permission-denied — caught by loadFeed catch handler). All 4 anonymous action buttons (like/save/share/bloom) correctly surface the 'Sign up to …' sonner toast and perform no writes. Community /community renders without crashing for anonymous users; the community-post-submit button shows the sign-up toast without attempting a write. Fresh-signup regression PASSES: newly created user reaches /dashboard, /feed loads 21 real Firestore posts (not the fallback), and like/save/share fire real success toasts. sanitize.js SCRIPT_STYLE_BLOCK regex verified via Node exec — '<script>alert(1)</script>hi' -> 'hi', '<style>…</style>hello' -> 'hello'. All 6 requested cases pass.
action_items: OPTIONAL: The console still logs 'Load feed failed, using fallback: Missing or insufficient permissions.' for anonymous visitors (expected until firestore.rules is redeployed via Firebase Console). Once rules are deployed, anonymous users will see real feed posts too. No user-visible impact today.
OPTIONAL: Signed-in feed briefly logs a Firestore WebChannel transient 'unavailable' error before recovering — cosmetic, not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: FALLBACK_FEED gracefully degrades anonymous experience without depending on Firestore rules deployment — good defensive pattern.
sanitize.js: SCRIPT_STYLE_BLOCK runs BEFORE HTML_TAG stripper so inner text of <script>/<style> is fully removed. Confirmed via unit-level exec.
Community anonymous path relies on button-level auth gate; no write is attempted at Firestore, so rules do not need updating for that flow.
AwesomeFeedPage still calls seedContentIfEmpty + generateDailyFeed only when user is truthy — no wasted Firestore write attempts for anon users.

seed_data_creation: No new community/feed seed created in this iteration; relied on existing 21 feed_posts already seeded by prior iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_4 critical bug is RESOLVED via fallback pattern. If the user redeploys firestore.rules to Firebase Console, expect anonymous /feed to also fetch the real 21 feed_posts instead of the 6-item FALLBACK_FEED — retest by checking counter reads '1 of 21' for anon users and console no longer warns 'Load feed failed'. Everything else in iteration_4 (9/10 flows) remained passing.
rca of the issue: PRIOR ROOT CAUSE: Firestore rules required auth for feed_posts read; anon getDocs rejected, catch handler left loading=true. FIX APPLIED: (1) firestore.rules updated (needs manual Firebase Console redeploy); (2) AwesomeFeedPage.loadFeed catch now sets FALLBACK_FEED, ensuring anon users see content immediately. VERIFICATION: anon /feed now shows '1 of 6 • Swipe for more' within 2s of load; loading testid absent; all action gates emit sign-up toasts.
